_comment: thicket_keeps_skill's start: mage 7 + warrior 3 (total 10, but NOT a COMBAT_BAND_FIXTURES row -- this route never fights). mage L7 grants [Detect Magic] and requires spell_cast >= 24, so the baseline's 13 is raised to 24; warrior L3 requires melee_hit >= 6, which the baseline's 18 already clears. hotbar_loadout is absent = AUTO, so every known field skill is on the bar and press_field_skill detect_magic resolves. heard_thicket_keeps pre-banked, quest already started. Built from riverfarm_fight_start (the region's shipped baseline: post-mounting, door_awakened + riverfarm_attuned, so riverfarm_village/riverfarm_mill/witch_hollow/witch_hut all satisfy test_fixture_coherence MAP_REQUIRES). Adds blight_lifted + heard_price_of_a_favor + price_of_a_favor_reported: both v0.16 side quests hang their start option off price_of_a_favor_reported, so a save that has not closed 'The Price of a Favor' cannot see them. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
